record.context_brief: Characterizing Koopman groups on Hilbert spaces
record.original_question: Use the Perron Frobenius spectral theory of positive C0 -groups to characterize unitary C0 -groups on a Hilbert space H that are unitarily isomorphic to a Koopman group on an L2 -space.

evidence.quote: Problem 18 (Characterizing Koopman groups on Hilbert spaces). Use the Perron Frobenius spectral theory of positive C0 -groups to characterize unitary C0 -groups on a Hilbert space H that are unitarily isomorphic to a Koopman group on an L2 -space.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space and let $U = (U_t)_{t \in \mathbb{R}}$ be a strongly continuous one-parameter unitary group on $H$ (i.e., a unitary $C_0$-group). Say that $U$ is a Koopman group if there exists a $\sigma$-finite measure space $(X, \Sigma, \mu)$ and a measurable measure-preserving flow $\varphi = (\varphi_t)_{t \in \mathbb{R}}$ on $X$ such that $U$ is unitarily isomorphic to the induced Koopman group $T = (T_t)_{t \in \mathbb{R}}$ on $L^2(X, \mu)$ defined by $T_t f = f \circ \varphi_t$. 

Recall that a $C_0$-group $(S_t)$ on a Banach lattice $E$ is called positive if $S_t \ge 0$ for every $t \in \mathbb{R}$, and that the Perron–Frobenius spectral theory of positive $C_0$-(semi)groups provides structural information about the peripheral spectrum of the generator and about cyclicity, lattice homomorphism, and ideal-invariance properties of the (semi)group.

Problem: Using the Perron–Frobenius spectral theory of positive $C_0$-groups, give a necessary and sufficient intrinsic characterization (in terms of $U$ and the geometry/operator-theoretic structure on $H$) of those unitary $C_0$-groups $U$ on $H$ which are unitarily isomorphic to a Koopman group on some $L^2$-space arising from a measure-preserving flow.
artifact.status_search_result: No published solution or characterization corresponding to this specific problem was located. It appears as an explicit open problem in a recent problem list on Koopman/positive $C_0$-(semi)group theory, and standard references on Koopman and Perron–Frobenius operators do not provide such an intrinsic characterization for unitary $C_0$-groups. Status appears to be open.

status_evidence.title: Koopman and transfer operator techniques
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Koopman/Perron–Frobenius operators on L^2 but does not give an intrinsic characterization of unitary C_0-groups arising as Koopman groups.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit intrinsic characterization is provided in standard recent references.

status_evidence.title: The Point Spectrum of Frobenius-Perron and Koopman Operators
status_evidence.snippet: Studies spectral properties of these operators in L^2 settings.
status_evidence.claim: Existing spectral results address point spectrum but do not yield a complete characterization of Koopman unitary groups.
